description: Searches abuse.ch ThreatFox for indicators of compromise matching a term (IP, IP:port, domain, URL or file hash): IOC, type, malware family, threat type, confidence, first/last seen, reporter, tags and Malpedia link. Optional exact match and a first-seen window in days. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: Only IOCs first seen in the last N days, 1 to 365 (default: no limit)

exact.description: true for exact match only (default false: partial match)

term.description: An IP, IP:port, domain, URL or hash to look for (required)

name: security_threatfox_iocs
title: Security Threatfox Iocs
